name: Incline press
cue: Lower the bar under your collarbones, then press straight up.
research: research.json biomech.incline_press: Smith machine, bench at 30 deg (back pad through the thorax_back and sacrum landmarks, 32.6 deg from horizontal), trunk -60, hips 45 (trunk-relative 41), knees 100 with vertical shins, feet flat. Bar on vertical rails (x +-0.36 H, just outside the sleeves), 0.018 H (3.2 cm) thick like a real Smith bar, so at the touch point it hides as little of the upper chest as possible (phone stage glow at the stretch 254 -> ~360 CSS px against the 4.4 cm bar), touching the upper chest just below the clavicles (thorax rest point y 0.785) and rising 0.2425 H (43 cm) straight up to a soft lockout (elbow ~6). Grip x 0.215 H (hands ~77 cm apart, ~1.85x biacromial; research ~1.5x). A narrower grip does not bring the bottom back toward the research 100 / -10: tools/design/incline_press_v3.mjs at 0.20 H gives elbow 129 and plane -29 at the touch point (0.19 H: 132 / -29), elbow 23-28 at the top of the 43 cm bar travel and 11-14 deg of forearm lean mid-rep; the bottom is set by the chest depth (the bar touches skin 0.075 H in front of the shoulder-joint centre). with a vertical bar path and a fixed grip the forearm cannot stay vertical through the whole rep, and the narrower the grip the more the forearms lean in mid-press (smallest possible lean, swivel searched per bar height: 14 deg at 0.19 H, 7 deg at 0.215 H, 5.5 deg at 0.22 H; tools/design/incline_press_v3.mjs). At 0.215 H the engine measures forearms within 5 deg of vertical at the bottom (elbows under the bar), at most 8.5 deg inward mid-rep, and a narrow Y at lockout (arms 20 deg from vertical in front view). Pole "fk" with mid keys M1-M4 at bar heights 0.2 / 0.45 / 0.7 / 0.85 whose FK elbows sit at that minimum-lean swivel (tools/design/incline_press_v3.mjs). Scapulae retracted (clav pro -14 -> -10) and depressed (elev -8 -> -5). Muscles: research primary is the clavicular pec; only the upper chest glows. pec_clav is a fan from the lateral clavicle along the medial clavicle and the manubrium down to the 2nd-3rd rib at the sternal edge (v [-0.5, 0.62]), converging on the axillary fold, so the two sides meet at the sternum at the lockout and the glow shows below the bar at the touch point (phone stage 390x481: ~300 CSS px at the stretch, ~680 at the peak) (one idea; the sternal pec is not drawn as secondary because it touches the primary and its large amber patch outweighed the upper-chest ember). Load: plates on the bar ends outboard of the rails. (tools/design/loads.mjs)

targets.note: The bar touching the upper chest with near-vertical forearms fixes the bottom: elbow ~125 (geometric target for the 0.215 H grip, research 100) and the humerus ~30 deg behind the trunk's frontal plane in this rig (the chest skin is 0.075 H in front of the shoulder-joint centre). The research 100 / -10 would stop the bar ~6 cm above the chest, a listed mistake; with a 2-bone arm the elbow angle at the touch point is set by the grip width alone. The lockout plane (~63 vs 78) follows from the same grip.

camera.note: Research view az 80 / el 10 (profile: the incline and the vertical bar path). Turned 24 deg toward the front and raised 19 deg (az 56 / el 29, 29.4 deg in all): on the 30 deg bench the upper chest faces 60 deg above horizontal, so looking down onto it lets it read above the arms, and from az 56 the near upper arm no longer hides the head at the lockout. From az 65-80 the near Smith rail runs along or across the back of the head at the bottom of the rep; from az 56-60 it passes clear of the head in every phase. The rails are vertical and parallel; looking down 29 deg the near rail, off to the left of the frame, still converges ~3.6 deg on a phone stage (true three-point perspective; it was 4.4 deg at el 33 with the rails at x 0.4). The rails and top bar reach 1.24 H so the crossbar crops off the top of the stage, and the machine stands on two bench feet, short rail feet and a foot plate under the feet only, so the horizon arc shows on both sides and the name sits on clean planet body.
